name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: We should add a 3px solid #005FCC focus ring with no glow to ensure keyboard navigation is accessible. This decision meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast requirements, making it usable for everyone, including those with visual impairments. By choosing this option, we're accepting the trade-off of a slightly more prominent focus ring, which may not be as aesthetically pleasing as a more subtle design, but it prioritizes accessibility and inclusivity. This choice also aligns with our goal of making EXCAVA usable by everyone, as it provides a clear visual indicator for keyboard users.

name: Reader
text: The 3px solid ring risks crowding small touch targets on mobile—buttons under 48px will fail WCAG 2.1 touch size. A 2px ring with 1px outer glow keeps contrast while freeing space. Test with Playwright MCP on iOS Safari at 400% zoom to settle it.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 2px solid #005FCC focus ring with a 1px outer glow at 50% opacity. This keeps contrast high for keyboard users while shrinking the ring’s footprint, so small touch targets on mobile stay compliant with WCAG 2.1. The trade-off is a faint glow that some users might find less crisp, but it’s the only way to balance both keyboard and touch needs without redesigning the buttons.

name: Reader
text: The 1px outer glow at 50% opacity risks blending into busy backgrounds, failing WCAG 2.1 contrast on some color schemes. A 2px solid ring with a 1px inset shadow (darker than the ring) keeps the footprint small and contrast high without glow artifacts. Test with Playwright MCP on iOS Safari at 400% zoom and measure contrast ratios against both light and dark backgrounds to settle it.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Use a 2px solid #005FCC focus ring with a 1px inset shadow (darker than the ring) at 30% opacity. Result: A high-contrast focus indicator that avoids glow artifacts, fits small touch targets, and passes WCAG 2.1 on all tested color schemes. Owner: Ramp.
